usdRate.sourceName: National Reserve Bank of Tonga daily exchange rates (USD/TOP mid 0.4175)
usdRate.note: TOP 1 = USD 0.4175 on 30 October 2026, so TOP 2.40 per US dollar; the same page showed 0.4170 on 1 November 2026 and NRBT Monetary Policy Data gives 0.4185 for July 2026.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Tonga Statistics Department, Statistical Bulletin: Consumer Price Index September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: All-items CPI 146.3 in September 2026 vs 130.6 a year earlier: 12.1% annual inflation (12.0% in August, 9.3% in July), led by food, transport, housing and restaurants.

inflation_projection.sourceName: NRBT 5% inflation reference rate (press release 27 August 2026)
inflation_projection.note: The NRBT steers by a 5% inflation reference rate; annual inflation ran 2-5.5% in 2025 before a fuel and food spike to 12.1% in September 2026, so we plan with the 5% reference.

policy_rate.sourceName: National Reserve Bank of Tonga, monetary policy press release
policy_rate.note: Policy rate held at 2% within a 0-4% interest rate corridor; statutory reserve deposit ratio 15%.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: National Reserve Bank of Tonga, Monetary Policy Data July 2026 (savings deposit rate)
savings_account_rate.note: Weighted average savings deposit rate 2.49%; posted rates vary from 0.2% to 5% by bank and balance (NRBT bank comparison, May 2026).

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: National Reserve Bank of Tonga, comparison of banks' interest rates (as of May 2026)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Posted 3-month rates for deposits under TOP 100,000 at the four banks: 0.35%, 0.75%, 1.25% and 3.50%; median 1.0%.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: National Reserve Bank of Tonga, Monetary Policy Data July 2026 (12-month term deposit rate)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Weighted average 12-month term deposit rate 3.32%; posted 1-year rates range 0.50% to 4.00% across banks (May 2026).

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product appears in the NRBT comparison of banks' products (May 2026).

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: National Reserve Bank of Tonga, Monetary Policy Data July 2026 (weighted average deposit rate)

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Searched NRBT pages: government bonds are listed by series, but no separate retail savings bond or certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No treasury bills are on issue per the NRBT government bonds page; NRBT Notes are central bank paper for banks.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: National Reserve Bank of Tonga, government bonds on issue (Series No.6 2026/2031)
tbond_5y_rate.note: Most 5-year government bonds issued in 2025-2026 carry 2.50-3.00% coupons; the latest 5-year series (18 September 2026) pays 3.00%.

tbond_10y_rate.note: NRBT government bonds page lists no 10-year series; the longest tenor on issue is 7 years (2.50%).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Ministry of Revenue and Customs, withholding tax guidance
tax_bank_interest.note: Resident companies paying interest to a resident person (other than a financial institution) withhold 10% of the gross interest; no specific exemption for bank deposits was found.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No retail savings certificate exists; tax treatment of government bond interest was not stated on the NRBT or Revenue pages.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme was found on NRBT pages.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: The NRBT bank comparison lists credit card fees but no card interest rate; no legal cap was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No local stock exchange; global equity index in pa'anga terms; NRBT Monetary Policy Data July 2026: 12-month term deposit 3.32%; 5-year government bond coupon 3.00%
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global index fund in pa'anga after a weak decade for world shares.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No local stock exchange; global equity index in pa'anga terms; NRBT Monetary Policy Data July 2026: 12-month term deposit 3.32%; 5-year government bond coupon 3.00%
equity_return_base.note: There is no local stock market, so the base is a global index in pa'anga, capped at the after-tax 12-month deposit (about 3%) plus under 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: No local stock exchange; global equity index in pa'anga terms; NRBT Monetary Policy Data July 2026: 12-month term deposit 3.32%; 5-year government bond coupon 3.00%
equity_return_high.note: High case near long-run world equity returns plus mild pa'anga weakening.

gold_return_low.sourceName: NRBT exchange rate (USD/TOP about 0.42, stable over 2025-2026 under a basket peg)
gold_return_low.note: Low case for gold in pa'anga: weak dollar gold price and a stable basket-pegged currency.

gold_return_base.sourceName: NRBT exchange rate (USD/TOP about 0.42, stable over 2025-2026 under a basket peg)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% plus slight expected pa'anga depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: NRBT exchange rate (USD/TOP about 0.42, stable over 2025-2026 under a basket peg)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and some pa'anga weakening.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: NRBT savings deposit rate 2.49% less 10% withholding
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings deposits at about 2.5% before a 10% withholding tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: NRBT Monetary Policy Data July 2026: 12-month term deposit 3.32%; 5-year government bond coupon 3.00%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 12-month deposits (3.32%) after 10% withholding and 5-year government bonds at 2.5-3.0%.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: NRBT Monetary Policy Data July 2026: 12-month term deposit 3.32%; 5-year government bond coupon 3.00%
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: the better posted 1-year deposit rates and 6-year government bonds at 3.5%.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio for Tonga was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates for Tonga were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical private hospital bill for Tonga was found; most care is at public hospitals.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium table for Tonga was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: NRBT 5% inflation reference rate; Tonga CPI September 2026 (health group 0.0% y/y)
goal_inflation_health.note: The September 2026 CPI health group was flat year on year (weight 0.2%) but that index is too small to plan with, so we use the 5% headline projection plus one point.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: NRBT 5% inflation reference rate; Tonga CPI September 2026 (education group +4.0% y/y)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices rose 4.0% year on year in the September 2026 CPI; we plan with the 5% headline projection plus half a point.

life_expectancy.note: UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 73.4 for 2026 (men 69.8, women 76.8).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026 (rows 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 80-84); totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 11.76 (2025, World Bank) gives 8.5; populationpyramid.net (UN WPP 2024) gives 16.1 for 2040 (6.2) and 14.1 for 2065 (7.1, populationpyramid.net/tonga/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: National Retirement Benefits Fund (NRBF), Our Services
retirement_age_default.note: NRBF normal retirement: member must be 60 and no longer employed (benefit available between 60 and 70); no separate statutory private-sector retirement age was found.

retirement_age_government.note: No official source for the civil service retirement age was readable; government staff are covered by a separate Retirement Fund.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: NRBT savings deposit rate 2.49% less 10% withholding
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings deposits after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: NRBT Monetary Policy Data July 2026: 12-month term deposit 3.32%; 5-year government bond coupon 3.00%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the after-tax 12-month deposit rate (3.32% less 10% = 2.99%).

retirement_return_high.sourceName: NRBT Monetary Policy Data July 2026: 12-month term deposit 3.32%; 5-year government bond coupon 3.00%
retirement_return_high.note: High case: laddered 5-6 year government bonds at 3.0-3.5% and better bank rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of local deposits/bonds (about 3%) and global equity
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix mostly in local deposits and bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of local deposits/bonds (about 3%) and global equity
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: half local fixed income at about 2.8% and half global equity at 6.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of local deposits/bonds (about 3%) and global equity
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with a larger, well-performing global equity share.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: National Retirement Benefits Fund (administers the Government Social Welfare Scheme), Our Services
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Social Welfare Scheme pays TOP 90 a month at ages 67-79 and TOP 110 from 80, to Tongan citizens living in Tonga (registered after 3 months' residence); paid monthly until death. Eligibility rule effective 1 July 2024.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: National Retirement Benefits Fund (administers the Government Social Welfare Scheme), Our Services
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: From 1 July 2024 every Tongan citizen aged 67+ may register regardless of work income or other pensions (not means-tested); higher rate of TOP 110 from age 80, no separate over-90 rate.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory gratuity or end-of-service payment for private employees was found; retirement savings run through NRBF.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: National Retirement Benefits Fund (NRBF), Our Services
public_pension_scheme.note: Defined-contribution fund for private-sector employees: 5% employee plus at least 7.5% employer; normal retirement benefit from 60 once employment ends; voluntary contributors allowed. Membership ages 18-70 per the NRBF information guide on nrbf.to.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit product listed in the NRBT bank comparison.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No separate retail savings bond; government bonds are listed by NRBT (see tbond_5y).

tbill_91d.note: No treasury bills on issue; NRBT Notes are for banks.

tbond_5y.note: Issued through the NRBT in 2- to 7-year series; 5-year coupons 2.5-3.0%.

tbond_10y.note: No 10-year series on issue; longest is 7 years.

equity_fund.note: No local stock exchange or locally offered mutual funds found.

gold.note: No legal restriction on buying gold was found; mainly sold as jewellery.

oldAgeAllowance.name: Social Welfare Scheme (Government of Tonga, administered by NRBF)
